items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Use: 跟 introduces the person one does an action together with, like a prepositional phrase in English (“with …”). It stands before the verb phrase, and 一起 “together” often goes right in front of the main verb.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 我常跟姐姐去看電影。
items.py: Wǒ cháng gēn jiějie qù kàn diànyǐng.
items.en: I often go to the movies with my sister.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 他跟朋友在咖啡店聊天。
items.py: Tā gēn péngyǒu zài kāfēi diàn liáotiān.
items.en: He is chatting with a friend at a café.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 我這個週末要跟同學去參觀展覽。
items.py: Wǒ zhè ge zhōumò yào gēn tóngxué qù cānguān zhǎnlǎn.
items.en: I’m going to an exhibition with classmates this weekend.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 我今天不跟朋友去KTV唱歌。
items.py: Wǒ jīntiān bù gēn péngyǒu qù KTV chànggē.
items.en: I’m not going to KTV with friends today.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 他不跟我們一起去故宮。
items.py: Tā bù gēn wǒmen yìqǐ qù Gùgōng.
items.en: He isn’t going to the Palace Museum with us.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 弟弟不跟我去吃日本菜。
items.py: Dìdi bù gēn wǒ qù chī Rìběn cài.
items.en: My younger brother isn’t coming with me for Japanese food.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 你要不要跟我去看棒球比賽？
items.py: Nǐ yào bú yào gēn wǒ qù kàn bàngqiú bǐsài?
items.en: Do you want to go with me to watch the baseball game?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 你常跟誰一起運動？
items.py: Nǐ cháng gēn shéi yìqǐ yùndòng?
items.en: Who do you usually exercise with?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 你跟不跟我們去圖書館看書？
items.py: Nǐ gēn bù gēn wǒmen qù túshūguǎn kànshū?
items.en: Are you coming with us to read in the library or not?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Usage note: 跟 must come before the verb phrase, like other prepositions (在, 到): 我跟他去, not *我去跟他.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Use: 怎麼 asks about the manner or method of an action — “how”. It is an adverb and goes right before the verb.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Contrast with 怎麼樣 zěnmeyàng “how is it / what do you think”, which is a state verb asking for an opinion or a description, not a method: 這個菜怎麼做？“How is this dish made?” vs. 這個菜怎麼樣？“What do you think of this dish?”

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 你們怎麼去臺南？
items.en: How are you getting to Tainan?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 這個字怎麼寫？
items.en: How do you write this character?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 這支新手機怎麼上網？
items.py: Zhè zhī xīn shǒujī zěnme shàngwǎng?
items.en: How do I get online with this new phone?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 這個菜怎麼做？

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 這首歌怎麼唱？
items.en: How do you sing this song?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Use: The adverb 比較 suggests a comparison without naming what is being compared — the other side is understood from context. It goes right before a state verb.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 今天比較熱。
items.en: Today is relatively hot. (hotter than usual / than yesterday)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 坐捷運比較快。
items.en: Taking the MRT is faster. (than the alternative just mentioned)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 我們家，姐姐比較會做飯。
items.py: Wǒmen jiā, jiějie bǐjiào huì zuòfàn.
items.en: In our family, my older sister is the better cook.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 昨天比較不熱。

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 他比較不喜歡坐公車。
items.py: Tā bǐjiào bù xǐhuān zuò gōngchē.
items.en: He’d rather not take the bus.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 高鐵和火車，你比較想坐哪一個？
items.py: Gāotiě hàn huǒchē, nǐ bǐjiào xiǎng zuò nǎ yí ge?
items.en: Between the HSR and the train, which would you rather take?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 你跟你姐姐，誰比較會做飯？
items.py: Nǐ gēn nǐ jiějie, shéi bǐjiào huì zuòfàn?
items.en: Between you and your sister, who’s the better cook?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Usage note: In everyday Mainland usage 比較 can simply mean “rather, quite”, without comparing anything (他的中文說得比較好 “he speaks Chinese quite well”). In the Taiwan usage followed in this lesson, 比較 always implies a comparison, even when the other side is left unsaid.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Use: 又 Vs 又 Vs says that two qualities are both true of the same person or thing.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Pattern: Subject + 又 + State Verb₁ + 又 + State Verb₂

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 這家餐廳的菜又便宜又好吃，所以我們常來吃。
items.py: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài yòu piányí yòu hǎochī, suǒyǐ wǒmen cháng lái chī.
items.en: The food here is both cheap and tasty, so we often eat here.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 坐高鐵又快又舒服，可是有一點貴。
items.py: Zuò gāotiě yòu kuài yòu shūfú, kěshì yǒu yìdiǎn guì.
items.en: The HSR is both fast and comfortable, though a bit pricey.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 這條路又遠又難走。
items.py: Zhè tiáo lù yòu yuǎn yòu nán zǒu.
items.en: This road is both long and hard to walk.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 這家店的臭豆腐又不臭又不辣，我覺得不好吃。
items.py: Zhè jiā diàn de chòudòufǔ yòu bú chòu yòu bú là, wǒ juéde bù hǎochī.
items.en: This shop’s stinky tofu is neither smelly nor spicy — I don’t think it’s good.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 我的舊手機又不能照相又不能上網，我想買新的。
items.py: Wǒ de jiù shǒujī yòu bù néng zhàoxiàng yòu bù néng shàngwǎng, wǒ xiǎng mǎi xīn de.
items.en: My old phone can neither take photos nor go online — I want a new one.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Use: 比 names both sides of a comparison directly: “A is more … than B”. Pattern: A + 比 + B + State Verb.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Degree adverbs like 很, 真 or 非常 cannot go before the state verb in a 比 sentence: *我的手機比他的很貴 and *坐高鐵比坐火車非常快 are both wrong. Use 比較 (有一點) instead, or put a specific number after the verb.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 山上的風景比這裡漂亮。
items.py: Shānshàng de fēngjǐng bǐ zhèlǐ piàoliang.
items.en: The view up in the mountains is more beautiful than here.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 我們學校比他們學校遠。
items.py: Wǒmen xuéxiào bǐ tāmen xuéxiào yuǎn.
items.en: Our school is farther than theirs.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 坐捷運比坐火車快。
items.py: Zuò jiéyùn bǐ zuò huǒchē kuài.
items.en: Taking the MRT is faster than taking the train.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 在家上網不比在學校快。
items.py: Zài jiā shàngwǎng bù bǐ zài xuéxiào kuài.
items.en: Using the internet at home isn’t faster than at school.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 我的車不比他的車貴。
items.py: Wǒ de chē bù bǐ tā de chē guì.
items.en: My car isn’t more expensive than his.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 坐公車不是比坐計程車快。
items.py: Zuò gōngchē búshì bǐ zuò jìchéngchē kuài.
items.en: Taking the bus isn’t faster than taking a taxi.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 他們學校比你們學校遠嗎？
items.py: Tāmen xuéxiào bǐ nǐmen xuéxiào yuǎn ma?
items.en: Is their school farther than yours?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: 這種手機比那種貴嗎？
items.py: Zhè zhǒng shǒujī bǐ nà zhǒng guì ma?
items.en: Is this kind of phone more expensive than that kind?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Goal: Talk about plans for free time.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Task: Fill in a short schedule (今天晚上, 明天中午, 明天晚上, 這個週末) with who you’ll go with, how you’ll get there, where you’re going, and what you’ll do — then tell a partner, e.g. 這個週末我要跟朋友坐公車到臺南去玩。

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Goal: Explain what you like or dislike about something, giving at least two reasons with 又…又….

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Task: Ask a partner these questions and have them answer with 又…又…, 所以…, e.g. A：你為什麼常坐高鐵？ B：高鐵又快又舒服，所以我常坐高鐵。

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Goal: Make a simple comparison, using 比 or 比較.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Task: In groups, pick one option from each pair below (go to the Palace Museum or the mountains; watch TV or sing at KTV; drink coffee or tea; take a scooter or play tennis). Decide together and explain your choice with 比 or 比較, then tell the class your group’s picks.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Goal: Name the different kinds of transportation and describe how to reach a destination.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Task: A friend or family member is visiting you in Taiwan and you want to take them to 陽明山 (Yangmingshan). In pairs, plan how you will get there (which transportation, from where, roughly how long it takes) and present your plan.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Bringing back local products as gifts for friends and family after a trip, or when returning to one’s hometown, is a long-standing habit in Chinese culture. In Taiwan, local governments encourage this by promoting goods that carry a place’s own character — food, crafts, and everyday items — which also supports the local economy.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Popular souvenirs include sweets and snacks (pineapple cakes and sun cakes among the best known), farm, sea and mountain products — tea from Ali Mountain (阿里山) is a classic example — items linked to a place's history, such as Hualien marble, and ordinary items printed with “Taiwan”, such as T-shirts, key chains and magnets.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: YouBike is Taipei’s public bicycle-sharing system: an unstaffed, digitally managed network of docking stations that runs around the clock. Riders can pick up a bike at one station and return it at another.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: The system is meant to make it cheap and easy to cover the “last mile” between home, a bus or MRT stop, and work or school — a cheap, eco-friendly link between other kinds of transportation that the government hopes will encourage people to drive less.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: Pinyin spelling: the finals “-iang” and “-ing” with no initial consonant

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: When a syllable has no consonant before the vowel “i” and the final is “-iang”, the spelling changes “i” to “y”: 央 yāng, 陽 yáng, 羊 yáng (not *iang).

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 8 · 坐火車去臺南
items.text: When a syllable has no consonant before the vowel “i” and the final is “-ieng”, the “e” is dropped and the spelling becomes “-ying”: 英 yīng, 影 yǐng, 應 yīng (not *ieng).

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 我男朋友十月五號要來臺灣看我。
items.py: Wǒ nánpéngyǒu shíyuè wǔ hào yào lái Táiwān kàn wǒ.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 你想帶他去哪裡玩？
items.py: Nǐ xiǎng dài tā qù nǎlǐ wán?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 還不知道。你有什麼建議？
items.py: Hái bù zhīdào. Nǐ yǒu shénme jiànyì?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 臺灣的夜市很有名。你們應該去逛逛。
items.py: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒumíng. Nǐmen yīnggāi qù guàngguàng.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 謝謝，還有什麼好玩的地方？
items.py: Xièxie, hái yǒu shénme hǎowán de dìfāng?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 臺灣的咖啡也很特別。臺北有很多咖啡店。
items.py: Táiwān de kāfēi yě hěn tèbié. Táiběi yǒu hěn duō kāfēi diàn.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 到哪裡喝咖啡比較好？
items.py: Dào nǎlǐ hē kāfēi bǐjiào hǎo?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 你們可以去貓空。那裡的風景很美。
items.py: Nǐmen kěyǐ qù Māokōng. Nàlǐ de fēngjǐng hěn měi.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 謝謝你。我決定帶他去貓空。你也一起去，好不好？
items.py: Xièxie nǐ. Wǒ juédìng dài tā qù Māokōng. Nǐ yě yìqǐ qù, hǎo bù hǎo?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 要是那時候我有空，就跟你們一起去。
items.py: Yàoshì nà shíhòu wǒ yǒu kòng, jiù gēn nǐmen yìqǐ qù.

items.text: Use: A time-when phrase says when something happens — a point on the calendar or clock (去年, 這個星期, 昨天, 六點). A time-duration phrase says how long something lasts — a stretch of time (一年, 這個星期要上五天的課, 半個鐘頭). The two expressions often look alike but are not interchangeable.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 我下個星期要去花蓮玩。
items.py: Wǒ xià ge xīngqí yào qù Huālián wán.
items.en: I’m going to Hualien next week. (time-when)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 我想在花蓮玩一個星期。
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng zài Huālián wán yí ge xīngqí.
items.en: I’d like to spend a week in Hualien. (time-duration)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 他昨天回國了。
items.en: He went back to his country yesterday. (time-when)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 這個電影要看三個鐘頭。
items.py: Zhè ge diànyǐng yào kàn sān ge zhōngtóu.
items.en: This movie takes three hours to watch. (time-duration)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: Use: A duration phrase answers “for how long”. It follows the verb directly: Subject + Verb + Duration.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: If the verb has an object, the verb must be repeated: Subject + Verb + Object + Verb + Duration.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: A duration phrase comes before the negative word, not after it: Subject + Duration + 不／沒 + Verb.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: If the verb is a separable verb (放假, 上課…), the duration is inserted inside it, with or without 的: 放三天的假 or 放假放三天.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 我想去花蓮玩一個星期。
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù Huālián wán yí ge xīngqí.
items.en: I’d like to go play in Hualien for a week.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 中文，我想學一年半。
items.py: Zhōngwén, wǒ xiǎng xué yì nián bàn.
items.en: Chinese — I’d like to study it for a year and a half.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 他打算教中文教一年。
items.py: Tā dǎsuàn jiāo Zhōngwén jiāo yì nián.
items.en: He plans to teach Chinese for a year.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 我每個星期學書法學兩天。
items.py: Wǒ měi ge xīngqí xué shūfǎ xué liǎng tiān.
items.en: I study calligraphy two days every week.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 學校下個月放三天的假。
items.py: Xuéxiào xià ge yuè fàng sān tiān de jià.
items.en: The school is giving three days off next month.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 他太忙了，所以兩天不能來上課。
items.py: Tā tài máng le, suǒyǐ liǎng tiān bù néng lái shàngkè.
items.en: He’s too busy, so he can’t come to class for two days.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 這裡沒有網路，所以我兩個星期不能上網。
items.py: Zhèlǐ méi yǒu wǎnglù, suǒyǐ wǒ liǎng ge xīngqí bù néng shàngwǎng.
items.en: There’s no internet here, so I can’t go online for two weeks.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: Use: A clause ending in 的時候 names the time something else happens, happened, or will happen — like an English “when” clause. The 的時候 clause usually comes first, and the main clause follows.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: 在山上看風景的時候，我覺得很舒服。
items.py: Zài shānshàng kàn fēngjǐng de shíhòu, wǒ juéde hěn shūfú.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: Nearly every television program in Taiwan — except live news — runs with Chinese subtitles that cannot be turned off, and viewers are used to watching with them on. A few things are usually given as reasons for this.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: One is that subtitles let people who are hard of hearing follow along. Another is that spoken Mandarin varies a good deal by region and accent, and by the other Chinese languages and dialects spoken across Taiwan, while the written characters stay the same; subtitles make programs easier to follow regardless of accent. A third reason has to do with tones: Chinese is a tonal language, and in connected speech those tones can shift and blend, so a string of sounds can be heard more than one way. The classic example is 基隆是雨港 Jīlóng shì yǔgǎng “Keelung is a rainy port”, which without subtitles could easily be misheard as 基隆是漁港 Jīlóng shì yúgǎng “Keelung is a fishing port” — seeing the characters removes the ambiguity.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 9 · 放假去哪裡玩？
items.text: Because Chinese characters are not an alphabet and the link between a written word and its sound is looser than in an alphabetic language, seeing the text alongside hearing it makes spoken Chinese noticeably easier to follow — which is part of why subtitles have become the norm.

items.text: Use: This pattern reduplicates a mono-syllabic action verb and ends with the cognitive verb 看. It suggests “try (verb) and see”, and because of 看, the sentence carries a highly tentative tone. Basic mono-syllabic action verbs work in this pattern, e.g. 吃, 喝, 打, 寫, 穿, 學, 做, 聽, 唱, 逛, 住.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: This pattern is closely related to the plain reduplication introduced in Lesson 6 (這杯咖啡很香，你喝喝看 ≈ 你喝喝). They are usually interchangeable, except when the sentence is not a request to try something (我週末常看看書、喝喝咖啡 — 看 cannot be added), and VV看 generally cannot take an object (you cannot say ＊喝喝看咖啡, though plain VV can: 喝喝咖啡).

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: Use: Reduplicating a state verb intensifies the statement, somewhat like 很 + state verb, but it expresses the speaker’s subjective feeling rather than an objective, factual observation.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: No degree adverb can appear with reduplication (not ＊這杯茶很香香的). A 的 follows the reduplicated state verb — 這杯茶香香的, not ＊這杯茶香香. When two state verbs appear in sequence, the first 的 can be dropped: 那種水果香香甜甜的.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: Not every state verb can be reduplicated. 香、甜、高、熱、大、美、遠、辣、矮 can; 多、貴、近、忙、新、少 cannot.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: Because reduplication is subjective, it tends to appear when describing or praising something, not in a plain factual statement — when ordering, say 買一杯熱咖啡, not ＊買一杯熱熱的咖啡.

items.py: Xiànzài qù nà jiā lǚguǎn de rén bǐjiào shǎo.
items.en: Fewer people go to that hotel now.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: 不喜歡吃水果的人可以試試看這種芒果。
items.py: Bù xǐhuān chī shuǐguǒ de rén kěyǐ shìshìkàn zhè zhǒng mángguǒ.
items.en: People who don’t usually like fruit could try this kind of mango.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: 不住旅館的旅客可以去住民宿。
items.py: Bú zhù lǚguǎn de lǚkè kěyǐ qù zhù mínsù.
items.en: Travelers who don’t stay at hotels can stay at a B&B instead.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: Use: The sentential 了 at the end of a sentence marks a change in situation — something has changed, resulting in a new state of affairs. It can be affirmative, negative, or a question.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: 這種芒果貴了。
items.en: This kind of mango has gotten expensive.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: 我現在喜歡吃西瓜了。
items.py: Wǒ xiànzài xǐhuān chī xīguā le.
items.en: I like watermelon now. (I didn’t before.)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: 去那家旅館住的人多了。
items.py: Qù nà jiā lǚguǎn zhù de rén duō le.
items.en: More people are staying at that hotel now.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: 我不喜歡吃芒果了。
items.py: Wǒ bù xǐhuān chī mángguǒ le.
items.en: I don’t like mango any more.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: 他不想住那家旅館了。
items.py: Tā bù xiǎng zhù nà jiā lǚguǎn le.
items.en: He doesn’t want to stay at that hotel any more.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: 你現在喜歡吃臺灣水果了嗎？
items.py: Nǐ xiànzài xǐhuān chī Táiwān shuǐguǒ le ma?
items.en: Do you like Taiwanese fruit now?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: 去花蓮玩的人少了嗎？
items.py: Qù Huālián wán de rén shǎo le ma?
items.en: Have fewer people been going to Hualien?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: Use: 因為…所以… links a cause clause to its effect. The two conjunctions almost always appear as a pair, reinforcing each other, and in Chinese the cause clause always comes first, unlike English where the order is more flexible.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: 因為現在去玩的人比較少，所以旅館不太貴。
items.py: Yīnwèi xiànzài qù wán de rén bǐjiào shǎo, suǒyǐ lǚguǎn bú tài guì.
items.en: Because fewer people are visiting now, the hotels aren’t too expensive.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: 因為這種水果很香很甜，所以很多人喜歡吃。
items.py: Yīnwèi zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ hěn xiāng hěn tián, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén xǐhuān chī.
items.en: Because this fruit is fragrant and sweet, a lot of people like to eat it.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: 因為我以前沒吃過芒果，所以想吃吃看。
items.py: Yīnwèi wǒ yǐqián méi chī guò mángguǒ, suǒyǐ xiǎng chīchīkàn.
items.en: Because I’d never had mango before, I wanted to try it.

items.text: In Chinese culture, three colors carry especially strong meanings: red, white, and yellow.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: Red is an auspicious color used for happy events. At traditional Chinese weddings, the garments and decorations are red, and wedding guests give red envelopes containing money for good luck. At Chinese New Year, people hang up red scrolls and couplets, and often write the character 福 fú (blessing) on red paper; adults give children money in red envelopes.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: White is the opposite: where red is for joy and birth, white is traditionally for mourning. At funerals, the family’s clothing and the items used are white, and visitors paying respects may offer a white envelope to the family. With Western influence, however, brides in Taiwan now also wear white wedding gowns, and — as in the West and in Japan — white has also come to carry a sense of purity.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 10 · 臺灣的水果很好吃
items.text: Yellow was historically reserved for the emperor and the royal family; the emperor’s own robe was called 黃袍 huángpáo, literally “yellow gown”, and yellow was the color of the highest class. Since the end of imperial China, the meaning of yellow has shifted a great deal — today the word is also used in the term 黃色書刊 huángsè shūkān, “pornographic publications”, a meaning with no connection to its old royal associations.

items.text: 陳小姐，妳好，我姓高，我來看房子。
items.py: Chén xiǎojiě, nǐ hǎo, wǒ xìng Gāo, wǒ lái kàn fángzi.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 這裡是客廳，右邊是廚房，廚房旁邊有浴室。
items.py: Zhèlǐ shì kètīng, yòubiān shì chúfáng, chúfáng pángbiān yǒu yùshì.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 房子不錯，很乾淨。

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 這裡很方便，附近有超市，走路五分鐘就到了，捷運站也不遠。
items.py: Zhèlǐ hěn fāngbiàn, fùjìn yǒu chāoshì, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le, jiéyùnzhàn yě bù yuǎn.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 現在有人住嗎？

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 沒有，還有一間空房間，是套房，房間裡面可以上網。
items.py: Méi yǒu, hái yǒu yì jiān kōng fángjiān, shì tàofáng, fángjiān lǐmiàn kěyǐ shàngwǎng.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 我想看看那間套房。妳覺得這個地方怎麼樣？
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng kànkàn nà jiān tàofáng. Nǐ juéde zhè ge dìfāng zěnmeyàng?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 很安靜，而且有一個學生已經住了兩年了。
items.py: Hěn ānjìng, érqiě yǒu yí ge xuéshēng yǐjīng zhù le liǎng nián le.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 聽起來不錯，我回去想想，再打電話給妳。
items.py: Tīng qǐlái búcuò, wǒ huíqù xiǎngxiǎng, zài dǎ diànhuà gěi nǐ.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 喂，陳小姐，妳好，我是高明，妳收到我的房租了嗎？
items.py: Wéi, Chén xiǎojiě, nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì Gāo Míng, nǐ shōudào wǒ de fángzū le ma?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 我已經收到了，謝謝。你習慣了嗎？
items.py: Wǒ yǐjīng shōudào le, xièxie. Nǐ xíguàn le ma?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 習慣了。可是，有一個問題，房間裡的網路好像不太快。
items.py: Xíguàn le. Kěshì, yǒu yí ge wèntí, fángjiān lǐ de wǎnglù hǎoxiàng bú tài kuài.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 這樣啊，我今天會請人來看看。你什麼時候方便？晚上可以嗎？
items.py: Zhèyàng a, wǒ jīntiān huì qǐng rén lái kànkàn. Nǐ shénme shíhòu fāngbiàn? Wǎnshàng kěyǐ ma?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 不好意思，今天晚上我有事，不能在家。
items.py: Bùhǎo yìsi, jīntiān wǎnshàng wǒ yǒu shì, bù néng zài jiā.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 好，我在家等你們。
items.py: Hǎo, wǒ zài jiā děng nǐmen.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 那我們明天下午三點到。還有問題嗎？
items.py: Nà wǒmen míngtiān xiàwǔ sāndiǎn dào. Hái yǒu wèntí ma?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 我想裝冷氣，請問可以嗎？
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng zhuāng lěngqì, qǐngwèn kěyǐ ma?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 可以，不過你得自己付錢。
items.py: Kěyǐ, búguò nǐ děi zìjǐ fùqián.

items.text: Use: 來 lái + VP indicates the subject’s intention of coming over to do something. Negation markers, auxiliary verbs, or adverbs go before the first verbal element 來.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: The function of 來 + VP here is the same as that of 去 + VP introduced in Lesson 3 — the only difference is the direction of the subject’s action: 來 is toward the speaker’s location, and 去 is away from it.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 我來看房子。
items.en: I’ve come to look at the place.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 房東來裝有線電視。
items.en: The landlord has come to install cable TV.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 我跟朋友來看套房。
items.py: Wǒ gēn péngyǒu lái kàn tàofáng.
items.en: My friend and I have come to look at the suite.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 我今天很忙，不來看房子了。
items.py: Wǒ jīntiān hěn máng, bù lái kàn fángzi le.
items.en: I’m busy today — I won’t come look at the place after all.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 他不跟我來看房間。
items.py: Tā bù gēn wǒ lái kàn fángjiān.
items.en: He isn’t coming with me to look at the room.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 你要來看套房嗎？
items.py: Nǐ yào lái kàn tàofáng ma?
items.en: Are you coming to look at the suite?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 房東會不會來修熱水器？
items.py: Fángdōng huì bú huì lái xiū rèshuǐqì?
items.en: Is the landlord coming to fix the water heater?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Use: When 就 refers to time or place, the event being discussed takes place sooner than expected. 就 often co-occurs with the sentence-final 了, though the sentence means the same with or without 了.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 就 is a high-frequency adverb with several functions — this lesson introduces its “sooner than expected” sense within a single sentence; Lesson 9 introduced a different, linking use of 就 (connecting 要是…就…).

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 這裡很方便，走路五分鐘就到了。
items.py: Zhèlǐ hěn fāngbiàn, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
items.en: It’s very convenient here — five minutes on foot and you’re there.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 那家房東不遠，很快就到了。
items.py: Nà jiā fángdōng bù yuǎn, hěn kuài jiù dào le.
items.en: That landlord’s place isn’t far — you’ll get there very quickly.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 房東等一下就來。
items.en: The landlord will be here in a bit.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Use: 有 introduces the existence of an indefinite subject; the following VP describes what that subject does. The subject in Chinese is usually definite, so when it is indefinite it must be preceded by 有. 有 is always negated with 沒.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: “有 + NP + 在 + location” means the same as “location + 有 + NP”, but the two differ in focus: 地上有一支手機 (‘The floor has a cellphone on it’) focuses on the floor, while 有一支手機在地上 (‘There is a cellphone on the floor’) focuses on the cellphone.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 有人要租這間套房。
items.py: Yǒu rén yào zū zhè jiān tàofáng.
items.en: Someone wants to rent this suite.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 有兩個學生來看房子。
items.py: Yǒu liǎng ge xuéshēng lái kàn fángzi.
items.en: Two students have come to look at the place.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 昨天有一個先生來修熱水器。
items.py: Zuótiān yǒu yí ge xiānshēng lái xiū rèshuǐqì.
items.en: Yesterday a man came to fix the water heater.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 這間套房沒有人住。
items.py: Zhè jiān tàofáng méi yǒu rén zhù.
items.en: No one is living in this suite.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 沒有人想租那個房間。
items.py: Méi yǒu rén xiǎng zū nà ge fángjiān.
items.en: No one wants to rent that room.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 有沒有人要看這間房子？
items.py: Yǒu méi yǒu rén yào kàn zhè jiān fángzi?
items.en: Is there anyone who wants to see this place?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 有沒有人不喜歡住套房？
items.py: Yǒu méi yǒu rén bù xǐhuān zhù tàofáng?
items.en: Is there anyone who doesn’t like living in a suite?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Use: 會 has two different meanings. The first, from Lesson 5, refers to an acquired skill — 會₁. The second, introduced here, refers to possibility or likelihood — 會₂.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 房東會修熱水器。（會₁）
items.en: The landlord knows how to fix water heaters. (acquired skill)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 我不會修網路。（會₁）
items.en: I don’t know how to fix the internet. (acquired skill)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 他明天會來看房子。（會₂）
items.py: Tā míngtiān huì lái kàn fángzi. (huì₂)
items.en: He will come look at the place tomorrow. (likelihood)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 房東今天不會來裝冷氣。（會₂）
items.py: Fángdōng jīntiān bú huì lái zhuāng lěngqì. (huì₂)
items.en: The landlord won’t come install the air conditioner today. (likelihood)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Use: In Chinese, old information already mentioned or understood from context is often omitted later. A pronoun that is omitted this way is called a “zero pronoun” (written ∅ below). The most frequently omitted elements are the subject and the object:

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 1. subject predictable from context, e.g. [landlord opening the door] ∅ 請進！ (You, please come in.)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 2. subject previously mentioned, e.g. 我姓高，∅ 叫高明。 (I’m surnamed Gao, (I’m) called Gao Ming.)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 3. object previously mentioned, e.g. 昨天房東給我一把鑰匙，我沒用 ∅。 (Yesterday the landlord gave me a key; I haven’t used (it).)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 我以前不喜歡住套房，∅現在很喜歡了。
items.py: Wǒ yǐqián bù xǐhuān zhù tàofáng, ∅ xiànzài hěn xǐhuān le.
items.en: I didn’t use to like living in a suite; (I) like it a lot now.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 那間房子很方便，∅走路五分鐘就到捷運站了。
items.py: Nà jiān fángzi hěn fāngbiàn, ∅ zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào jiéyùnzhàn le.
items.en: That place is convenient; (it’s) five minutes on foot to the MRT station.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 房東給我一把鑰匙，我不想用∅。
items.py: Fángdōng gěi wǒ yì bǎ yàoshi, wǒ bù xiǎng yòng ∅.
items.en: The landlord gave me a key; I don’t want to use (it).

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Goal: Learning to use indefinite subjects to describe events.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Task: Imagine a classmate took a walk around their neighborhood and snapped a few photos to share online. Help write a caption for each one, saying where the action took place, using 有 + person + 在 + location + VP.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 1. 有一個學生在學校打籃球。 2. 有兩個朋友在咖啡店聊天。 3. 有一個女生在客廳唱歌。 4. 有兩個朋友在飲料店喝手搖飲。

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Goal: Learning to talk about the environment of a room or a house.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Task: Pair up with a classmate and describe your current residence, or your residence back home. As you listen to your partner, sketch a floor plan of their place and label each room (客廳, 廚房, 浴室, 房間…).

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Goal: Learning to comprehend a passage and add to it.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Task: Form groups of two or three. Read the following story and complete it with your partners, then read the finished story to the class.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 高明的室友昨天已經搬走了。現在他一個人住，他想，房間裡好像有一點安靜，可是也有一點無聊。他打電話給房東，問她還有沒有空房間，房東說，剛好還有一間套房，就在他隔壁。高明覺得這是個好機會，所以……（請幫他想想吧！）

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Goal: Learning to understand rental advertisements.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Task: Imagine you and a friend see the ad below. Discuss it using the questions that follow.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 租 — 近捷運站、超市、學校。兩套衛浴，有廚房。冰箱、網路、有線電視一應俱全。月租一萬二，不包水電。地址：中山路三巷八號三樓。意者請電林太太 02-23456789 / 0912345678。

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 1. 租這個房子一個月要多少錢？ 2. 租這個房子，可以做飯嗎？ 3. 要是我想看房子，應該打電話給誰？打哪個電話？

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: 4. 什麼是「衛浴」？ 5. 你現在住的房子比這個房子好嗎？ 6. 要是你想租房子，你會租這個地方嗎？為什麼？

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Goal: Learning to make requests, e.g., to one’s landlord.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Task: You have just started renting a place, but you’ve discovered that the internet isn’t working and the kitchen has no hot running water. Call your landlord, tell them about the problems, and ask them to take care of it. (Have a classmate role-play the landlord.)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: While real estate agents do handle some rental listings, in Taiwan it’s more common for landlords to rent out their own places directly — often advertised on simple flyers posted around a neighborhood.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Renting in Taiwan is very much a free market: although there are going rates for a given area, the final rent is set by the landlord, and it’s normal to negotiate it down a bit. Once landlord and tenant agree and sign a lease, that agreement is legally binding.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 11 · 我要租房子
items.text: Application fees or background-screening fees aren’t part of the process. A landlord may ask for a deposit of up to two months’ rent, but prepaying the final month’s rent in advance is not the usual practice.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: Use: This pattern highlights one element in a sentence about a past event and marks it as the focus — the main message of the sentence. The focus marker 是 goes directly before the focused element, and 的 goes at the end of the sentence (Subject + 是 + Focus + Activity + 的). The object is often moved to the very front of the sentence.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: The focused element can be the subject, the time, the place, the manner, and occasionally the verb — but never the object. 是 can be omitted; the pattern can also ask a wh-question (who, when, how, where) about a past event, but it does not work when “what” is the object. 不 always goes before 是.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: 他是去年來臺灣工作的。
items.py: Tā shì qùnián lái Táiwān gōngzuò de.
items.en: It was last year that he came to Taiwan to work. (time)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: 學費是爸媽替我付的。
items.py: Xuéfèi shì bàmā tì wǒ fù de.
items.en: It is my parents who pay my tuition for me. (object fronted)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: 是我打電話給老闆的。
items.py: Shì wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi lǎobǎn de.
items.en: It was I who called the boss. (subject)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: 他是坐高鐵來臺北上班的。
items.py: Tā shì zuò gāotiě lái Táiběi shàngbān de.
items.en: It was by High Speed Rail that he came to Taipei for work. (manner)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: 她不是去年找到工作的。
items.py: Tā búshì qùnián zhǎo dào gōngzuò de.
items.en: It was not last year that she found the job.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: 不是我決定要打工的。
items.py: Búshì wǒ juédìng yào dǎgōng de.
items.en: It wasn’t I who decided to work part-time.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: 你是什麼時候開始打工的？
items.py: Nǐ shì shénme shíhòu kāishǐ dǎgōng de?
items.en: When did you start working part-time?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: 你的獎學金是怎麼申請的？
items.py: Nǐ de jiǎngxuéjīn shì zěnme shēnqǐng de?
items.en: How did you apply for your scholarship?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: Use: 以後 is basically a noun with two functions here. Used alone, like a time word, it means “some time in the future”: 我以後想當老師 (In the future, I’d like to become a teacher). Used together with an event — Event + 以後, Result — it connects two events sequentially, meaning “after Event, Result”.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: 我以後想找一個常常要說中文的工作。
items.py: Wǒ yǐhòu xiǎng zhǎo yí ge chángcháng yào shuō Zhōngwén de gōngzuò.
items.en: In the future, I’d like to find a job where I often need to speak Chinese. (alone)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: 畢業以後，我要回國找工作。
items.py: Bìyè yǐhòu, wǒ yào huíguó zhǎo gōngzuò.
items.en: After graduating, I’m going to go back to my country to find a job.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: 來臺灣以後，我每天都說中文。
items.py: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, wǒ měi tiān dōu shuō Zhōngwén.
items.en: Since coming to Taiwan, I speak Chinese every day.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: 下課以後，我常在圖書館打工。
items.py: Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ cháng zài túshūguǎn dǎgōng.
items.en: After class, I often work part-time at the library.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: Use: When 好 or 難 combine with perception verbs (吃, 喝, 看, 聽…), they form single words meaning “nice/not nice to [do]” — 好吃/難吃, 好喝/難喝, 好看/難看, 好聽/難聽. When they combine with action verbs, 好 means “easy to” and 難 means “difficult/hard to” — 好學/難學, 好找/難找, 好做/難做, 好寫/難寫.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: Degree adverbs such as 很 can modify both structures.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？

items.en: This job pays well, but it’s hard to find.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: 老師說的中文故事很好聽。
items.py: Lǎoshī shuō de Zhōngwén gùshì hěn hǎotīng.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: Being polite at all times is considered important in Chinese culture, and the workplace is no exception — how people are addressed depends on several factors.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: The most common way to address someone is by their job title: a manager might be called 王經理 Wáng Jīnglǐ (“Manager Wang”), or a professor 李教授 Lǐ Jiàoshòu (“Professor Li”). People may also be addressed by the highest academic title they hold — 陳博士 Chén Bóshì (“Dr. Chen”), or more fully 文學博士陳月文 Wénxué Bóshì Chén Yuèwén (“Dr. of Literature Chen Yuewen”). Another method is by profession, such as 張老師 Zhāng Lǎoshī (“Teacher Zhang”) or 王議員 Wáng Yìyuán (“MP Wang”, a member of parliament). When someone’s title or profession is unknown, 小姐 (Miss), 女士 (Madam), or 先生 (Mister) are also polite.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 12 · 你在臺灣學多久的中文？
items.text: Taiwanese people sometimes ask friends from abroad questions like “Where do you work?”, “How much do you make?”, “Are you married?”, “How many children do you have?”, and “Are they boys or girls?” While many foreigners consider these kinds of questions intrusive, in Taiwanese culture they’re generally seen as a sign of interest and a way of breaking the ice.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 祝
items.en: to wish (somebody happiness, good luck, etc.)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 哪裡，哪裡
items.en: Don’t mention it, it’s my pleasure.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 大部分

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 萬事如意

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 心想事成
items.en: May all your wishes come true.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Use: The pattern 一 A 就 B describes a sequence of two events, with B happening right after A. Both events can be affirmative or negative. 一 and 就 are adverbs and come after the subject of their own clause; when the subject of both clauses is the same, the second subject is usually dropped.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 我一下課，就去圖書館門口等你。
items.py: Wǒ yí xiàkè, jiù qù túshūguǎn ménkǒu děng nǐ.
items.en: I’ll go wait for you at the library entrance as soon as I’m out of class.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 他一記得你的生日，就馬上打電話給你。
items.py: Tā yí jìde nǐ de shēngrì, jiù mǎshàng dǎ diànhuà gěi nǐ.
items.en: As soon as he remembered your birthday, he called you right away.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 我朋友一回來，就訂了一個蛋糕。
items.py: Wǒ péngyǒu yì huílái, jiù dìngle yí ge dàngāo.
items.en: As soon as my friend got back, she ordered a cake.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Use: The verbal 了 is added right after the verb to show that an action has already happened or been completed, in contrast to a plan that has not yet taken place. 了 does not appear in negative sentences — 沒 replaces it instead — and questions add 沒有 at the end of the sentence.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 如玉已經訂了一個生日蛋糕。
items.py: Rúyù yǐjīng dìngle yí ge shēngrì dàngāo.
items.en: Ruyu has already ordered a birthday cake.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 他昨天教了我一點西班牙文。
items.py: Tā zuótiān jiāole wǒ yìdiǎn Xībānyá wén.
items.en: He taught me a little Spanish yesterday.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 我吃了豬腳麵線，也吃了蛋糕。
items.py: Wǒ chīle zhūjiǎo miànxiàn, yě chīle dàngāo.
items.en: I ate pork-knuckle noodles, and I also had cake.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 我今天沒訂蛋糕，明天再訂。
items.py: Wǒ jīntiān méi dìng dàngāo, míngtiān zài dìng.
items.en: I didn’t order the cake today — I’ll order it tomorrow instead.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 他沒忘記你的生日，只是太忙了。
items.py: Tā méi wàngjì nǐ de shēngrì, zhǐshì tài máng le.
items.en: He didn’t forget your birthday — he was just too busy.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Use: 不 and 沒 are both negation markers, but they attach to different kinds of verbs. Action verbs can take either 不 (habitual or an intention not to) or 沒 (something that didn’t happen in the past). State verbs — adjective-like verbs such as 忙, 熱心, 一樣 — can only be negated by 不. Process verbs — verbs describing a change, such as 忘, 決定, 結束 — can only be negated by 沒.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 我平常不喝咖啡，不過今天想喝一杯。
items.py: Wǒ píngcháng bù hē kāfēi, búguò jīntiān xiǎng hē yì bēi.
items.en: I usually don’t drink coffee, but today I feel like having a cup. (habitual)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 他不去夜市，想在家休息。
items.py: Tā bú qù yèshì, xiǎng zài jiā xiūxí.
items.en: He’s not going to the night market — he wants to rest at home. (intention)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 昨天太忙了，我沒打電話給她。
items.py: Zuótiān tài máng le, wǒ méi dǎ diànhuà gěi tā.
items.en: I was too busy yesterday, so I didn’t call her. (non-happening, action verb)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 這家餐廳的菜不貴，大家都喜歡來。
items.py: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài bú guì, dàjiā dōu xǐhuān lái.
items.en: The food at this restaurant isn’t expensive — everyone likes to come.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 我的生日跟他的不一樣。
items.py: Wǒ de shēngrì gēn tā de bù yíyàng.
items.en: My birthday isn’t the same as his.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 我還沒決定要訂什麼蛋糕。
items.py: Wǒ hái méi juédìng yào dìng shénme dàngāo.
items.en: I still haven’t decided what cake to order.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 語言交換還沒結束，我們再聊一下。
items.py: Yǔyán jiāohuàn hái méi jiéshù, wǒmen zài liáo yíxià.
items.en: The language exchange hasn’t ended yet — let’s chat a bit more.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Use: Question words such as 誰, 哪裡, 什麼, 什麼時候, and 怎麼+V can appear in statements rather than questions. Paired with 都 dōu, they show total inclusion (“everyone”, “everywhere”, “no matter how”) in affirmative sentences; with 都 or 也 plus a negative, they show total exclusion (“no one”, “nowhere”, “not at all”).

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 誰都想在生日的時候收到禮物。
items.py: Shéi dōu xiǎng zài shēngrì de shíhòu shōudào lǐwù.
items.en: Everyone wants to receive a gift on their birthday.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 這家店的蛋糕什麼都好吃。
items.py: Zhè jiā diàn de dàngāo shénme dōu hǎochī.
items.en: Everything at this shop’s cake counter is delicious.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 他怎麼過生日都很開心。
items.py: Tā zěnme guò shēngrì dōu hěn kāixīn.
items.en: No matter how he celebrates his birthday, he’s always happy.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 今天太忙了，我哪裡都沒去。
items.py: Jīntiān tài máng le, wǒ nǎlǐ dōu méi qù.
items.en: I was too busy today — I didn’t go anywhere.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 他這個星期什麼時候都不在家，在準備考試。
items.py: Tā zhè ge xīngqí shénme shíhòu dōu bú zài jiā, zài zhǔnbèi kǎoshì.
items.en: He’s not home at all this week — he’s preparing for an exam.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Use: Pre-verbal 多 (“more”) and 少 (“less/fewer”) describe doing more or less of an action than originally planned or than usual. 一點 often follows the object to soften the amount, and the pattern can describe either past or future actions.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 海鮮比較貴，我們少點一點。
items.py: Hǎixiān bǐjiào guì, wǒmen shǎo diǎn yìdiǎn.
items.en: Seafood is relatively pricey — let’s order a bit less.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 他喜歡吃蔬菜，我多買了一點。
items.py: Tā xǐhuān chī shūcài, wǒ duō mǎile yìdiǎn.
items.en: He likes vegetables, so I bought a bit extra.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 今年他的生日人比較多，我們應該多訂一個蛋糕。
items.py: Jīnnián tā de shēngrì rén bǐjiào duō, wǒmen yīnggāi duō dìng yí ge dàngāo.
items.en: More people are coming to his birthday this year, so we should order an extra cake.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Use: 是不是 asks for confirmation of something the speaker already believes or finds obvious, rather than asking for brand-new information, as 嗎 or A-not-A questions do. Structure: Subject + 是不是 + VP？ This pattern must be used, instead of A-not-A, with sentences that already contain 比 (comparison) or a degree adverb such as 太/很.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 你是不是忘了他的生日？
items.py: Nǐ shìbúshì wàngle tā de shēngrì?
items.en: You forgot his birthday, didn’t you?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 這家餐廳是不是很有名？
items.py: Zhè jiā cāntīng shìbúshì hěn yǒumíng?
items.en: This restaurant is famous, isn’t it?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 你是不是比他忙？
items.en: You’re busier than him, aren’t you? (comparison — A-not-A is not possible here)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Use: 跟…一樣 compares two people or things and states that they are the same or equal; the quality being compared, if given, follows 一樣. Structure: A 跟 B 一樣 (state verb). Negating with 不 before 一樣 says the two are different; negating with 不 before 跟 instead shifts the “different” object, so the sentence then says what A is the same as.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 我的生日跟田中的一樣，都是十二月。
items.py: Wǒ de shēngrì gēn Tiánzhōng de yíyàng, dōu shì shí'èr yuè.
items.en: My birthday is the same as Tanaka’s — both are in December.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 這個蛋糕跟那個一樣甜。
items.py: Zhè ge dàngāo gēn nàge yíyàng tián.
items.en: This cake is just as sweet as that one.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 他跟我一樣，都喜歡交外國朋友。
items.py: Tā gēn wǒ yíyàng, dōu xǐhuān jiāo wàiguó péngyǒu.
items.en: He’s like me — we both enjoy making foreign friends.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 海鮮跟蔬菜不一樣貴。
items.py: Hǎixiān gēn shūcài bù yíyàng guì.
items.en: Seafood and vegetables don’t cost the same.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: 他不跟我一樣高，跟如玉一樣高。
items.py: Tā bù gēn wǒ yíyàng gāo, gēn Rúyù yíyàng gāo.
items.en: He’s not the same height as me — he’s the same height as Ruyu.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Goal: Learning to ask people about their preferences.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Task: You heard that a classmate went to the night market yesterday. Ask whether they tried each item below, using the verbal 了 pattern, e.g. 你昨天逛夜市，吃了珍珠奶茶沒有？ Possible answers: 喝了，很好喝 / 沒有，我點了別的飲料 / 我沒喝珍珠奶茶.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Items to ask about: 牛肉麵、小籠包、甜點、珍珠奶茶、臭豆腐、熱咖啡、芒果、豬腳、越南菜、西瓜、熱烏龍茶、牛肉湯.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Goal: Learning to compare cultures briefly.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Task: Pair up with a classmate from a different country and ask each other how birthdays are celebrated back home. Check off which of the following apply, then report to the class the similarities and differences you found: family celebrates it for you / friends celebrate it for you / celebrated at home / eaten out at a restaurant / cake is eaten / friends give gifts / you buy your own cake to share with friends / pork-knuckle noodles are eaten / it’s different from how we do it here.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Goal: Learning to make appointments on the phone.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Task: Your teacher’s birthday is tomorrow. Pair up with a classmate and call each other to plan taking the teacher out for a meal. In your call, be sure to cover: why you’re inviting him/her, what time to meet, where to meet, and how everyone will find each other there.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Goal: Learning to express wishes on happy occasions.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Task: It’s your teacher’s birthday today. Write him or her a short card wishing them well, using at least one of the phrases 萬事如意 or 心想事成.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Chinese culture places a lot of value on saying the right caring thing, at the right moment, for the right occasion — this is part of why congratulatory expressions are so common. Most of these set sayings are four-character phrases with a fixed, auspicious meaning, often used together, such as 萬事如意、心想事成 wànshì rúyì, xīnxiǎng shìchéng, “may everything go your way and all your wishes come true” — probably the most all-purpose good wish of all, suitable for almost any happy occasion, not only birthdays. These phrases turn up everywhere from spoken well-wishes to red envelopes and decorative scrolls hung at home.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 13 · 生日快樂
items.text: Traditionally, birthdays in Taiwan were tracked by the lunar calendar, though most people today mark theirs by the regular Gregorian calendar instead. Birthdays matter a good deal in Taiwanese culture, and some are celebrated more elaborately than others: a baby’s first month and first full year are both commonly marked with a gathering, and so are milestone decades later in life, such as turning 60, 70, or 80. One well-known custom tied to a baby’s first birthday is 抓週 zhuāzhōu (“grabbing at the first year”): a variety of small objects are placed in front of the child, and whichever one they reach for and grab is taken as a playful sign of the kind of personality or career they might have later in life.

items.text: Practice dialogue written for this site with the vocabulary of Dialogue I. The book’s own Dialogue I is on book p. 300; its recording is track 14-01.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 外面風這麼大，我覺得今天比昨天冷多了。臺灣會不會下雪？
items.py: Wàimiàn fēng zhème dà, wǒ juéde jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng duō le. Táiwān huì bú huì xiàxuě?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 平地不會，不過很高的山會下雪，玉山常常下雪。美國呢？開始下雪了嗎？
items.py: Píngdì bú huì, búguò hěn gāo de shān huì xiàxuě, Yùshān chángcháng xiàxuě. Měiguó ne? Kāishǐ xiàxuě le ma?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 還沒，我們那裡差不多十二月底才開始下雪。冬天真的很冷，我不太喜歡冬天。
items.py: Hái méi, wǒmen nàlǐ chàbùduō shí'èryuè dǐ cái kāishǐ xiàxuě. Dōngtiān zhēn de hěn lěng, wǒ bú tài xǐhuān dōngtiān.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 我也怕冷，我比較喜歡春天。
items.py: Wǒ yě pà lěng, wǒ bǐjiào xǐhuān chūntiān.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 春天不錯，不過我覺得秋天更好，天氣很舒服，還可以看紅葉。
items.py: Chūntiān búcuò, búguò wǒ juéde qiūtiān gèng hǎo, tiānqì hěn shūfú, hái kěyǐ kàn hóngyè.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 我去年秋天在紐約玩了兩個星期。那個時候，天氣很好，紅葉也很漂亮，我玩得很開心。
items.py: Wǒ qùnián qiūtiān zài Niǔyuē wánle liǎng ge xīngqí. Nàge shíhòu, tiānqì hěn hǎo, hóngyè yě hěn piàoliàng, wǒ wán de hěn kāixīn.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 我在臺灣住了半年多了，有一點想家。
items.py: Wǒ zài Táiwān zhùle bàn nián duō le, yǒu yìdiǎn xiǎng jiā.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 新年快到了，你想不想回去看父母？
items.py: Xīnnián kuài dào le, nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng huíqù kàn fùmǔ?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 想啊，不過我只放五天的假，所以明年夏天才要回去。
items.py: Xiǎng a, búguò wǒ zhǐ fàng wǔ tiān de jià, suǒyǐ míngnián xiàtiān cái yào huíqù.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 那你今年新年打算做什麼？
items.py: Nà nǐ jīnnián xīnnián dǎsuàn zuò shénme?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 我想留在臺灣，跟朋友一起過新年，下雪的時候再跟弟弟去山上滑雪。
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng liú zài Táiwān, gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ guò xīnnián, xiàxuě de shíhòu zài gēn dìdi qù shānshàng huáxuě.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 如玉，雨下得這麼大，妳怎麼沒帶傘？
items.py: Rúyù, yǔ xià de zhème dà, nǐ zěnme méi dài sǎn?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 我早上出門的時候還沒下雨，所以沒帶傘。
items.py: Wǒ zǎoshàng chūmén de shíhòu hái méi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ méi dài sǎn.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 聽說颱風快要來了。
items.py: Tīngshuō táifēng kuài yào lái le.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 我已經在新聞上看到了。
items.py: Wǒ yǐjīng zài xīnwén shàng kàndào le.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 這裡夏天常常有颱風，颱風來的時候，風和雨都很大，出門很不方便。
items.py: Zhèlǐ xiàtiān chángcháng yǒu táifēng, táifēng lái de shíhòu, fēng hàn yǔ dōu hěn dà, chūmén hěn bù fāngbiàn.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 對啊，到處都濕濕的，我真的很討厭颱風天。
items.py: Duì a, dàochù dōu shīshī de, wǒ zhēnde hěn tǎoyàn táifēngtiān.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 新聞說這次的颱風比上次的更大，要大家多小心。
items.py: Xīnwén shuō zhè cì de táifēng bǐ shàng cì de gèng dà, yào dàjiā duō xiǎoxīn.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 希望這次沒有上次那麼可怕。
items.py: Xīwàng zhè cì méiyǒu shàng cì nàme kěpà.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 妳看，雨好像停了。
items.py: Nǐ kàn, yǔ hǎoxiàng tíng le.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 太好了！謝謝你借我傘，再見。
items.py: Tài hǎo le! Xièxie nǐ jiè wǒ sǎn, zàijiàn.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 不客氣，慢走，小心一點。

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Use: Verb + Time-Duration shows how long a completed activity lasted. If the verb is transitive and takes an object, the verb must be repeated (Verb + Object + Verb + Time-Duration); if the object is moved to the front of the sentence instead, no repetition is needed.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 月美在紐約玩了兩個星期。
items.py: Yuèměi zài Niǔyuē wánle liǎng ge xīngqí.
items.en: Yuemei spent two weeks in New York.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 我們在家等颱風，等了兩天。
items.py: Wǒmen zài jiā děng táifēng, děngle liǎng tiān.
items.en: We waited at home for the typhoon for two days. (verb repeated — has an object)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 這場雨，我們等了半個小時才停。
items.py: Zhè chǎng yǔ, wǒmen děngle bàn ge xiǎoshí cái tíng.
items.en: This rain — we waited half an hour before it stopped. (object fronted — no repetition needed)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Use: Verb + 了 + Time-Duration + 了 (“Double 了”) shows how long an action has lasted up to the moment of speaking. The action may or may not still be continuing, depending on context.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 這個颱風已經來了兩天了。
items.py: Zhè ge táifēng yǐjīng láile liǎng tiān le.
items.en: This typhoon has already been here for two days.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 雨已經下了一整天了。
items.py: Yǔ yǐjīng xiàle yì zhěng tiān le.
items.en: It’s already been raining all day.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 我在臺灣住了半年多了。
items.py: Wǒ zài Táiwān zhùle bàn nián duō le.
items.en: I’ve already been living in Taiwan for over half a year.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Use: Sentential 了 often appears with adverbs 快, 要, or 快要 to show that something will happen soon — an imminent change of state. In Taiwan, the two-syllable 快要 is preferred when there’s no time word in the sentence; if a specific time word is present, 快要 cannot be used (just 要…了, or the sentence states the time directly).

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 颱風快要來了，大家要小心。
items.py: Táifēng kuàiyào lái le, dàjiā yào xiǎoxīn.
items.en: The typhoon is about to arrive — everyone should be careful.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 快下雪了，你多穿一點衣服。
items.py: Kuài xiàxuě le, nǐ duō chuān yìdiǎn yīfú.
items.en: It’s about to snow — put on some more clothes.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 新年快到了，我想回去看父母。
items.py: Xīnnián kuài dào le, wǒ xiǎng huíqù kàn fùmǔ.
items.en: New Year is coming up soon — I want to go back and see my parents.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Use: The adverb 更 adds that a fact is even more true than a fact already established — it implies the thing being compared to was already a certain way, and the new one is even more so. 更 is used together with 比, and as an adverb it goes right before the state verb it modifies. Questions about this pattern typically use 是不是.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 今年冬天比去年更冷。
items.py: Jīnnián dōngtiān bǐ qùnián gèng lěng.
items.en: This winter is even colder than last winter. (last winter was already cold)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 這次的颱風比上次的更大。
items.py: Zhè cì de táifēng bǐ shàng cì de gèng dà.
items.en: This typhoon is even bigger than the last one.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 我覺得秋天比春天更舒服。
items.py: Wǒ juéde qiūtiān bǐ chūntiān gèng shūfú.
items.en: I think autumn is even more pleasant than spring.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Use: A 沒有 B 那麼/這麼 + state verb says A is not as [adjective] as B. This pattern is almost always negative; 那麼/這麼 can sometimes be dropped. Its positive counterpart, A 有 B 那麼/這麼 + state verb, is rare except in 嗎 questions. Note the three-way contrast: A 跟 B 一樣 (equal, Lesson 13), A 沒有 B 那麼 (inferior), A 比 B (superior, Lesson 8). Questions use the A-not-A form (有沒有).

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 今年的颱風沒有去年的那麼可怕。
items.py: Jīnnián de táifēng méiyǒu qùnián de nàme kěpà.
items.en: This year’s typhoon isn’t as scary as last year’s.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 春天沒有秋天這麼舒服。
items.en: Spring isn’t as pleasant as autumn.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: 紐約的冬天沒有臺北的冬天那麼濕。
items.py: Niǔyuē de dōngtiān méiyǒu Táiběi de dōngtiān nàme shī.
items.en: Winter in New York isn’t as wet as winter in Taipei.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Goal: Learning to describe the four seasons and explain why you like or dislike them.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Task: Tell the class about the climate of your home country. Which season do you like the most, and which the least? Why? (因為…所以…)

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Goal: Learning to make simple statements about your experiences.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Task: Ask your classmates where they have lived and how long they lived in each place. Record your findings and report to the class, e.g. 安同在西班牙住了多久？ 安同在西班牙住了兩個月（了）。

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Goal: Learning to make comparisons between events.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Task: Compare the average temperatures of Taipei in the various seasons of last year and this year, using the patterns 比、更、比較、比…更、跟…一樣、沒有…那麼 introduced in this and earlier lessons.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Goal: Learning to compare weather conditions.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Task: Earlier you learned what the climate is like in a classmate’s home country. Compare the climate there with your own in more detail — spring, summer, autumn, winter, whether there are typhoons, whether it rains often, and whether it snows — and record the results on a chart.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Goal: Learning to discuss events and activities in summer.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Task: Discuss with a classmate what summer in Taiwan is like — the weather, the fruit people often eat, and the things people often do — and write down your findings in Chinese.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: A “typhoon day” is a break from school and work announced when a typhoon with strong enough winds is expected to hit an area within the next few hours; school and work are called off until the storm passes.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 14 · 天氣這麼冷！
items.text: Because a typhoon's heavy wind and rain can make daily life genuinely unsafe, the power to call off work and school was given to a government agency back in the early 1990s. That agency weighs the official weather forecast together with suggestions from local governments when making the call. Today the decision is no longer made for the whole country at once — it has been handed over to regional governments instead, so one city can call a typhoon day while its neighbor doesn't. To find out whether school or work is cancelled where you are, check the local news or the relevant government website.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 王小姐，妳怎麼了？

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 我這兩天一直流鼻水，頭很痛，胃口也很差，什麼都不想吃。
items.py: Wǒ zhè liǎng tiān yìzhí liú bíshuǐ, tóu hěn tòng, wèikǒu yě hěn chā, shénme dōu bù xiǎng chī.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 我看看妳的喉嚨。喉嚨有一點發炎，妳也有一點發燒，應該是感冒了。
items.py: Wǒ kànkàn nǐ de hóulóng. Hóulóng yǒu yìdiǎn fāyán, nǐ yě yǒu yìdiǎn fāshāo, yīnggāi shì gǎnmào le.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 請問我生病了，需要吃藥嗎？
items.py: Qǐngwèn wǒ shēngbìng le, xūyào chī yào ma?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 需要，妳先去藥局拿藥。
items.py: Xūyào, nǐ xiān qù yàojú ná yào.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 好的。請問我的病什麼時候會好？
items.py: Hǎode. Qǐngwèn wǒ de bìng shénme shíhòu huì hǎo?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 把藥吃了，多喝水，多休息，早一點睡覺，很快就會好。
items.py: Bǎ yào chīle, duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí, zǎo yìdiǎn shuìjiào, hěn kuài jiù huì hǎo.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 大衛，你怎麼了？臉色這麼難看。
items.py: Dàwèi, nǐ zěnme le? Liǎnsè zhème nánkàn.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 我昨天晚上肚子很不舒服，吐了好幾次。
items.py: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshàng dùzi hěn bù shūfú, tùle hǎo jǐ cì.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 你這麼不舒服，要不要我跟你一起去看病？
items.py: Nǐ zhème bù shūfú, yào bú yào wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù kànbìng?

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 不用了，我在臺灣沒有健康保險，我想自己去藥局買藥就好。
items.py: Búyòng le, wǒ zài Táiwān méiyǒu jiànkāng bǎoxiǎn, wǒ xiǎng zìjǐ qù yàojú mǎi yào jiù hǎo.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 你真的不去看病嗎？學校的健康中心很方便，而且不用付很多錢。
items.py: Nǐ zhēnde bú qù kànbìng ma? Xuéxiào de jiànkāng zhōngxīn hěn fāngbiàn, érqiě búyòng fù hěn duō qián.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 好吧，那麻煩妳陪我去健康中心。
items.py: Hǎo ba, nà máfán nǐ péi wǒ qù jiànkāng zhōngxīn.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 好。你要多小心，冰的、油的東西最好都別吃。
items.py: Hǎo. Nǐ yào duō xiǎoxīn, bīng de, yóu de dōngxi zuìhǎo dōu bié chī.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 謝謝妳的關心。

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 醫生說我吃一包藥，睡一個小時以後就會好一點。
items.py: Yīshēng shuō wǒ chī yì bāo yào, shuì yí ge xiǎoshí yǐhòu jiù huì hǎo yìdiǎn.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 太好了，你趕快回家休息吧。
items.py: Tài hǎo le, nǐ gǎnkuài huíjiā xiūxí ba.

items.text: Use: When a question word (什麼, 多少, 幾, 哪裡, 什麼地方, 誰, 什麼時候, etc.) occurs in a statement rather than in a question, it shows the speaker is giving a vague, non-committal answer instead of a clear one. A non-committal statement like this is always negative.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 我感冒了，什麼東西都不想吃。
items.py: Wǒ gǎnmào le, shénme dōngxi dōu bù xiǎng chī.
items.en: I've caught a cold — I don't feel like eating anything at all.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 她生病了，哪裡都不想去。
items.py: Tā shēngbìng le, nǎlǐ dōu bù xiǎng qù.
items.en: She's sick — she doesn't want to go anywhere.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 我這幾天沒有胃口，吃不下多少東西。
items.py: Wǒ zhè jǐ tiān méiyǒu wèikǒu, chī bú xià duōshǎo dōngxi.
items.en: I haven't had any appetite these past few days — I can't manage to eat much of anything.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: Use: 把 bǎ, the “disposal construction,” describes how the subject disposes of or handles a definite object. Structure: 把 + definite object + (bare, one-syllable, outward-transitive) verb + 了. The object must be definite (a bare noun, or one modified by 這個, 那個, 他的, etc.). Negation uses 沒 or 別 before 把.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 我把藥吃了。

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 她把感冒藥放在包包裡了。
items.py: Tā bǎ gǎnmào yào fàng zài bāobāo lǐ le.
items.en: She put the cold medicine in her bag.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 護士把我的藥拿來了。
items.py: Hùshì bǎ wǒ de yào ná lái le.
items.en: The nurse brought my medicine over.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: Use: The pattern “V 了…就…” shows that the second event happens right after the first one is completed. It differs from the 一…就… pattern (Lesson 13) in that the verbal phrase after V了 is not restricted to being short, and 以後 can be added after V了 (but not after 一).

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 他看了醫生就回家了。
items.py: Tā kànle yīshēng jiù huíjiā le.
items.en: He went home right after seeing the doctor.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 我吃了藥就覺得舒服多了。
items.py: Wǒ chīle yào jiù juéde shūfú duō le.
items.en: I felt a lot better right after taking the medicine.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 她下了課就去藥局拿藥。
items.py: Tā xiàle kè jiù qù yàojú ná yào.
items.en: She went to the pharmacy to get medicine right after class.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: Use: 一點 yìdiǎn indicates a minimal quantity or degree. It can go before a noun as its modifier (一點 + NP), after a state verb to show comparison (Vs + 一點, “a little more/less…”), or after 有 before a state verb without implying comparison (有(一)點 + Vs).

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 她喝了一點熱湯，覺得舒服多了。
items.py: Tā hēle yìdiǎn rè tāng, juéde shūfú duō le.
items.en: She drank a bit of hot soup and felt a lot more comfortable.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 這個藥有一點苦，可是很有效。
items.py: Zhè ge yào yǒu yìdiǎn kǔ, kěshì hěn yǒuxiào.
items.en: This medicine is a bit bitter, but it's very effective.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 請你早一點回家休息。
items.py: Qǐng nǐ zǎo yìdiǎn huíjiā xiūxí.
items.en: Please go home a bit earlier to rest.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: Use: This pattern compares how an action is performed. Most commonly: Action + 得 + Comparative + State, with the verb repeated when it takes an object (e.g., 看病看得比…快). Negation places 不 before 比.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 這位醫生看病看得比較仔細。
items.py: Zhè wèi yīshēng kànbìng kàn de bǐjiào zǐxì.
items.en: This doctor examines patients more carefully.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 弟弟睡覺睡得比我晚。
items.py: Dìdi shuìjiào shuì de bǐ wǒ wǎn.
items.en: My younger brother goes to sleep later than I do.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 她吃藥吃得不比我快。
items.py: Tā chī yào chī de bù bǐ wǒ kuài.
items.en: She doesn't take her medicine faster than I do.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: Use: A degree of difference can be added after a comparison with 比 using …一點 (a little), …得多 (a lot), or …多了 (a lot more). All three go after the state verb.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 這次的感冒比上次嚴重一點。
items.py: Zhè cì de gǎnmào bǐ shàng cì yánzhòng yìdiǎn.
items.en: This cold is a little more serious than the last one.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 喝熱湯比喝冷水舒服得多。
items.py: Hē rè tāng bǐ hē lěng shuǐ shūfú de duō.
items.en: Drinking hot soup is a lot more pleasant than drinking cold water.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 我現在覺得比早上好多了。
items.py: Wǒ xiànzài juéde bǐ zǎoshàng hǎo duō le.
items.en: I feel a lot better now than I did this morning.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: Use: Separable verbs have the inherent structure [V+N]; an element — 了, an object, or a time-duration — can be inserted between the V and the N, after which the two behave like a verb and its object. Examples among the words of this lesson: 看病, 生病, 睡覺.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 他這個月看了三次病。
items.py: Tā zhège yuè kànle sān cì bìng.
items.en: He's seen a doctor three times this month.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 我想睡一個下午的覺。
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng shuì yí ge xiàwǔ de jiào.
items.en: I'd like to sleep the whole afternoon.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: 她照顧了我好幾天。
items.py: Tā zhàogùle wǒ hǎo jǐ tiān.
items.en: She took care of me for several days.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服

items.text: Seeing someone wearing a surgical mask on the street in Taiwan doesn't necessarily mean that person is ill.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: Because colds spread easily through the respiratory system, especially when the seasons are changing, many people wear a mask on crowded buses or the MRT simply to lower the chance of catching or spreading one.

items.title: A1 Textbook · Pelajaran 15 · 我很不舒服
items.text: People wear masks for other everyday reasons too: scooter riders wear them in winter to stay warm and to filter out exhaust and dust; restaurant staff wear them so that they don't unintentionally let anything land in the food they're preparing; and in hospitals, both staff and patients wear them to help prevent infections from spreading. In short, a mask in Taiwan is usually a simple precaution, not a sign that something is wrong.

items.title: Band A Reading · Series 1 · Soal 46
items.text: （一） 曾有一項調查發現，很多員工生病的時候不敢請假，因為他們擔心老闆會不高興，覺得他們沒有責任感。有人認為，員工會這麼想是公司的責任。一個好的公司應該能照顧員工，而不是讓他們拿健康去換錢。因此，讓員工有幸福感，應該是未來企業努力的方向。 這篇文章說了什麼內容？ 老闆應該給員工多一點兒假 常關心別人的人更有責任感 對公司有意見要勇敢說出來 照顧身體比認真工作更重要

items.title: Band A Reading · Series 1 · Soal 47
items.text: （二） 如果你每天都覺得身體很累，有一份報告或許可以告訴你原因。這份報告提到了下面幾種可能：不愛運動、水喝得不夠多、總是把事情想得太壞、不吃早餐、吃太多沒營養的食物等。以上幾點，只要簡單思考一下自己符合了幾項，再試著做出一些改變，想讓自己更健康一點也不難。 在改善健康方面，下面哪一個是作者的建議？ 要培養運動的好習慣 想要吃什麼就吃什麼 平常應該多做點好事 吃早餐以後不要喝水

items.title: Band A Reading · Series 1 · Soal 48
items.text: （三） 從前有一個地方很久都不下雨，人們不管怎麼求雨都沒有用。有一次，他們從很遠的地方，請來一位有智慧的老人，希望他可以幫幫忙。老人在附近走了走、看了看，然後告訴他們，請蓋一間小屋，讓他住進去三天，三天當中，他任何人都不見。結果，三天後真的下雨了。大家都問他是怎麼做到的，他只回答，只要自己的心安靜了，外面就安靜了，所以下雨了。 這個故事告訴了我們什麼事？ 先照顧自己，才能幫助別人 想改變環境，就先改變心情 年輕人應該要學會尊敬老人 聰明的人知道什麼時候下雨

items.title: Band A Reading · Series 1 · Soal 49
items.text: （四） 說到錢，每個人對它的想法、使用方式和重視程度都不一樣。有人說：「錢是沒有性格的，它在誰的手上就像誰」。這句話說得很有道理，人們因為對錢的看法不同，而選擇不同的生活方式。比方說，有的人喜歡看到銀行裡的數字不斷增加，所以每天努力工作，很少花錢；有的人覺得錢只要夠用就好，不必太在意工作，因為「自己的時間」，也是一種看不到的「錢」。 這段話說了下面哪件事？ 錢比什麼都重要 錢可以解決所有事情 人人有自己對錢的看法 錢得放在銀行裡才有價值

items.title: Band A Reading · Series 1 · Soal 50
items.text: （五） 以前，電影院的門口常常出現一個牌子，要觀眾別帶外面買的食物進去，如果想吃東西，只能買電影院裡賣的食物。後來，新聞說，觀眾其實可以拒絕配合這些電影院的規矩。說到這個問題，我認為，電影院的要求不是沒有道理，因為電影結束以後，他們還得打掃那些垃圾。其次，如果有人帶了一些有奇怪味道的食物進電影院，也很容易影響其他看電影的人。 作者對在電影院裡吃東西的行為怎麼看？ 應該要避免吃有特別味道的東西 覺得吃什麼東西都是個人的自由 認為電影院的要求沒有任何道理 看電影的人都有責任要打掃垃圾

items.text: （十一） 2011 年，研究人員找了 59 人，分別以七種不同語言大聲讀出 20篇相同的短文。他們發現，被大眾認為語速極快的日語和西班牙語，每秒音節數最多；華語是這七種語言中速度最慢的，接著是德語。 研究人員進一步計算每種語言所含的資訊量。他們發現，西班牙語每個音節傳達的資訊很少；相對地，華語每個音節裡包含了較多資訊，可能是因為華語的音節還帶有四聲。但是，對聽話的人來說，結果卻是西班牙語和華語傳達資訊的速度一樣。研究人員認為，各語言傳達資訊的速度是一樣的，可能和人類的感覺系統接收資料的速度與資料量有關。 1950 年代，語言學家喬姆斯基提出了「普遍語法概念」，他認為儘管各種語言聽起來都不同，卻具有共通的語法結構。這個說法鼓舞了語言學界，但要找到真正的共同結構，卻比想像中困難。 但就上述的研究顯示，各語言都在確保說話者與聽者之間能穩定的交流，所以，自 1950 年後科學家找出了各語言間的共同

items.text: （九） 有三個正在學畫的年輕人，打算把自己的作品以一千元賣出，他們的顧客都說了相同的話：「您的畫恐怕還沒有一千元的價值吧？」其中一人聽了以後，仔細看了看自己的畫，最後不但以兩千元賣掉畫，還更加努力成為著名的畫家。另一人聽了以後只是把畫撕了，從此不畫了，他努力學習攝影而成為有名的攝影大師。第三人以為自己的畫真的不夠好，就降價以五百元賣出。最後他為了生活，只能在路邊賣些沒有價值的便宜畫作。 批評有正面的鼓勵效果，可以讓人繼續努力往前走，或是指引你走向另一條成功的路；但它有時候是毒藥，會誤了別人一生。其實人的一生會遇到無數的批評，但自己的人生自己決定，在面對批評時反省與思考，就有機會使毒藥成為解藥。 作者最後希望讀者怎麼做？ 盡量對年輕人多說好話 勿學買畫的顧客亂殺價 要試著學習講價的技巧 想好自己要過哪種生活

items.text: （十） 你聽過「熱狗水」嗎？如果有人告訴你，它可以讓你減輕體重、增加活力，價格是一般飲料的二十倍，你買不買？在溫哥華上週的無車日活動上，就擺了一個賣熱狗水的攤子，雖然商品說明聽起來很吸引人，可是誰都看得出來，它就是一瓶水裡面泡著一條熱狗而已，最後卻仍在活動當天賣出了六十瓶。 那些人在掏出錢包之前，一定都沒有仔細閱讀瓶子包裝上面的小字：「熱狗水是希望鼓勵大家批判思考，並意識到自己的消費行為究竟是受何種因素左右。」原來這是一個行為實驗，目的是觀察人們是否會相信這樣誇張的商品。受騙的人買到教訓了嗎？那得看他們是否知道自己上當了，即使知道，恐怕也不保證他們下一次不會再度賠上冤枉錢。 這篇文章主要探討哪件事？ 推銷語言的影響力 健康飲料有何好處 如何設計商品包裝 消費者心態的變化

items.title: Band B Reading · Series 5 · Soal 41
items.text: （十二） 在某些社會文化中，由於「一個人吃飯」通常與被孤立、沒朋友、不懂社交等負面印象聯繫在一起，所以一個人走進餐廳就成了許多人害怕的事。但，獨自吃飯真是一件那麼糟糕的事嗎？ 事實上，一個人並不意味著寂寞，與此相反，更可以將注意力放在享受餐盤上的美食。當然，與他人分享、交流時能帶給人們滿足與快樂，而當你已經在人際相處上付出了許多時間後，更應該為自己保留一些獨處的空間；當你因為獨自吃飯而害怕被貼上「人際障礙」的標籤時，也許根本沒有人注意到你，或是覺得你性格古怪。 忙碌的生活常常讓我們忽略與自己獨處的重要性，哪怕是一頓飯、一部電影的時間，都是面對自己的好機會。久而久之，你將發現，那些異樣眼光只是一種自我限制，而能一個人吃飯，竟然是那麼寶貴。 作者認為有些人害怕一個人吃飯的原因是什麼？ 不敢違反社交規定 太在意別人的想法 不能分享最新的消息 擔心錯過朋友的邀請

items.title: Band B Reading · Series 5 · Soal 44
items.text: （十三） 在商業活動中，與他人見面交流時，第一步常是交換名片。只是拿到這麼多名片，一方面容易遺失，一方面經過長時間，名片都可以堆成小山了，不只查找不便，也浪費很多空間。 好在電子時代來臨，現在很多人已經選擇使用電子名片。初次見面的時候，雙方可以打開彼此手機裡的電子名片程式，利用自動輸入功能交換彼此的資料。除了可以快速輸入與查找資料外，還能連結手機裡的電話、電子郵件與地圖。和傳統名片不同的是，它能隨時更新資料和照片，不需要換名片，減少了製作名片的材料和成本。只可惜，目前在一些網路不發達的區域，無法隨意使用電子名片，而且要讓不同的名片程式能夠相互交換資料是有困難的。如果要讓電子名片更普遍，仍然需要政府協助建設網路，以及民間企業的配合才行。 作者覺得使用傳統名片的缺點是什麼？ 交換時常浪費不少時間 其材質容易弄髒不耐用 收到太多名片很難找資料 年輕人很少使用傳統名片

items.text: （四） 自兩億多年前的侏儸紀之初，體型巨大就是陸生動物的普遍特點。動物為什麼要長成巨無霸呢？有些理由是顯而易見的：身軀愈大愈不易被獵殺，而且還利於撲殺獵物。例如羚羊很容易淪為獅子、土狼和獵犬的獵物；但成象及犀牛則幾乎不受威脅，牠們的子女也因父母體型巨大而得到保護。對草食動物來說，長得巨大表示「高人一等」，可以吃到更高處的樹葉。長頸鹿及大象就有長到五公尺高的，而大象尚可利用龐大的身軀推倒高樹。 其他重要卻不明顯的理由有：運動消耗的能量會隨體型增大而減少，故一隻五公噸重的大象走一公里路所消耗的能量，比一群總重五公噸的瞪羚走同樣路程要少很多。此外，新陳代謝率也會隨體型增大而降低。這就是為什麼鼩鼱每天都得吞入超過其體重的食物，而大象只需吃進占體重 5％的食物便足矣。不僅如此，龐大的身體也具有像隔熱板一樣的保溫作用，讓動物不受環境劇烈溫差的影響。 不過，長得巨大也是有害處的。因為大的動物吃得多，其總

items.text: （五） 未來的道路收費的方式可能和目前的制度大不相同。在 GPS 等無線定位技術問世後，我們便能精確地計算開車成本和道路價值，一個嶄新的交通觀念於是產生：讓駕駛人依據實際開車的里程數來支付道路費用。專家們相信，這樣的做法能有效改善塞車問題，以及降低意外事故。 目前多數國家的道路費用是透過汽車牌照稅、燃料稅等等來徵收。駕駛人無論是使用擁擠或是空曠的道路，所支付的費用相同；一個月只開一次車的人所支付的費用，也跟每天開車的人一樣，說起來並不是很合理。 近來荷蘭政府推動一項實驗，依照駕駛人實際開車的里程來收費，而且，流量越高的道路，收費也越高。實驗顯示，計畫實施後，有高達七成的駕駛人選擇在離峰時間上路、或避開擁擠的路段，有效改善市區交通。 按里程收費對環保也有助益。在德國，大貨車的計費標準不只是里程，還包括了廢氣排放量，污染越嚴重的貨車得支付越高的里程費。按里程收費實施之後，高污染貨車的行駛次數便

items.text: （四） 「花間一壺酒，獨酌無相親」，這兩句詩表達出李白的心情。他在奼紫嫣紅的花叢間，擺上一壺酒。在醺然的狀態下，邀了天上的明月一起對飲。這樣的良辰美景，應該是三五好友，知心共享的時刻，李白卻只能喟嘆。月亮、李白與李白的影子，對影成三人。 月亮不會飲酒，和自己的影子飲酒更是平添寂寞。但是，李白終究灑脫。趁著春光正盛，恣意歌詠，至歡快處，手舞足蹈不也酣暢淋漓、大快人心。李白就這樣從最初的落寞，到任著自己的心情，在月下舞著、蹈著、唱著，還和白玉盤有了天際渺渺之約。 李白不需要走到人生的困境，才懂得駐足欣賞眼前的風景，他總是隨走隨看隨領略。即便孤身一人，總有艱辛，他也能將之轉化與天地同歡，而這番了悟，妙筆一揮，遂成詩裡行間的風景。 在我看來，人生泰半是挫折與苦難。但是，若偕李白同行，每每到水窮處時，必定聽見李白放聲大歌。伴著歌聲，試著將挫折烹調成一盤下酒菜。咀嚼於舌尖的況味，終將消化於人生的坦然。

items.text: （五） 多數人以為，超大質量黑洞應存在於巨大星系的中心位置。但日前，已有天文學家在銀河系邊緣，發現了幾十個超大質量黑洞。這些黑洞在環繞銀河系主體，由恆星和氣體構成近似於球形的「恆星暈」區域中閒逛著。 天文學家認為，黑洞之所以存在於宿主星系邊緣的現象，是來自星系合併的結果，這現象經常發生在一個不斷膨脹的宇宙中。當一個較小的星系融入一個更大的主星系時，它會把自己中央的超大質量黑洞置於新的宿主星系上。《天體物理學雜誌快報》刊發的研究報告進一步預測，與銀河系具有相近質量的星系，應該包含著不只一個超大質量的黑洞。 該報告的研究員表示，由於工具的限制，想直接論斷黑洞的存在是不可能的。即使想間接推斷它們是否存在，也必須要有更好的方法與手段才行。因為，每 1000 億年左右，才能與影響太陽系的漫遊黑洞近距離接觸，從人類角度來看，其生發頻率極低；再加上，因為預測漫遊的超大質量黑洞位於離星系中心很遠且處於星系

items.text: （六） 美沙酮是一種合成類鴉片的藥物。1970 年代起，美國和歐洲國家主張由政府提供美沙酮給吸毒者，用來替代海洛因，幫助吸毒者戒除毒癮。由於戒除海洛因的過程非常痛苦，極難根除，美沙酮作為一個毒性較低的藥品，能幫助吸毒者在無法戒除毒癮的情況下，緩解毒癮、抗拒使用海洛因的誘惑。 美沙酮的使用時有爭議。台灣在九十年代初期，就有醫界人士建議政府引進美沙酮。不過當時研究顯示，大多服用美沙酮的毒癮患者必須終生服用，僅有不到 5%的人可以成功擺脫對美沙酮的依賴。使用美沙酮似乎是以毒攻毒的疑慮，讓這項提議始終停留在紙上談兵的階段。 然而隨著毒品日益氾濫，不少專家不得不重新評估，認為使用美沙酮是兩害相權取其輕的做法。海洛因市價極高，毒癮患者經常為了籌錢購買毒品鋌而走險、到處犯案，若由政府提供美沙酮給毒癮患者，就可降低因毒品而產生的社會犯罪。此外，自從愛滋病出現後，由於口服的美沙酮不必由靜脈注射，可以避免愛滋
